mapper.sql: empId, empName, empPhone, empDepartment, empPosition, entryTime, isArchived, createTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee(empName, empPhone, empDepartment, empPosition, entryTime, isArchived, createTime) VALUES (#{empName}, #{empPhone}, #{empDepartment}, #{empPosition}, #{entryTime}, #{isArchived}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM employee WHERE empPhone = #{phone} ORDER BY empId DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee WHERE empPhone = #{phone} AND isArchived = 0
SELECT DISTINCT empDepartment FROM employee WHERE empDepartment IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(empDepartment) != '' ORDER BY empDepartment

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM employee
AND empName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{empName}, '%')
AND empDepartment LIKE CONCAT('%', #{department}, '%')
